## Turning Strategy Into Execution

I am a Strategic Management student at BYU's Marriott School of Business with a strong interest in product, program, and project management. My background centers on coordinating people, priorities, and data to execute complex work. I enjoy roles where structure, planning, and follow-through turn ideas into tangible results.

## Background

Through leadership roles managing teams of 20 or more, setting KPIs, and tracking progress across multiple initiatives, I have developed a disciplined approach to planning and execution. I am comfortable working cross-functionally, communicating status clearly, and using data to inform decisions. I am especially interested in work at the intersection of strategy and execution, where good program management enables teams to move faster and with more clarity. Most recently, I interned on State Farm's Property Express claims team, where I resolved 231 claims and authorized over $550,000 in payments, and earned a full-time return offer.

## What You'll Find Here

This site is where I share projects I'm working on and document what I'm learning. You'll find examples of my work in strategic management, analytics, and development, things I've built to solve real problems or explore ideas I find interesting.

## Skills

My work draws on strong analytical skills, including advanced Excel, SQL, R, and AI application development, alongside a focus on clear communication and coordination.
